notes.title: Graphics update!
notes.notes: A new update has been released. For the popular demand, I increased the quality of graphics for both lower and higher settings. Be sure to check it out! :)

notes.title: Changeset for 2018 May 18
notes.notes:
Fixed some lighting issues on Low quality settings.
The play field has a slightly darker tint for better visibility.

notes.title: Changeset for 2018 May 17
notes.notes:
We've identified two minor bugs, both happens after completing the tutorial.
 - You'll no longer see the remains of the tutorial text box
 - The first level will not bring you back to the menu when using the magnet switch after completing the tutorial.

notes.title: Getting ready for the release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Only 7 days left until the release! 
I finally finished all the levels, so 64 shiny new ones await you soon!
I'd like to send a big thank you to every beta tester, for helping me pursue this wonderful job and make this game happen!
Thank you all for your support!
